name: Vehicles
description: Vehicle details, registrations, odometer readings, fuel and charging logs for an owned item.
captureExamples: The car odometer is at 42,000 miles.
My Ontario plate is 00-DEMO. This registration expires January 31, 2027.
notes: Manufacturer/make and model belong to the parent Belongings item. Vehicle-specific identifiers, registration, model year, odometer and energy history belong here.

Registration belongs to the vehicle as one encrypted record per issuance. The owner can correct reviewed fields. Vehicle viewer/editor assignments do not grant access to registration details. Link a supporting scan in Files.

capture.identity: Resolve the Belongings item and vehicle. Match a registration by issuing jurisdiction, plate or registration number, and issuance period. Plate numbers can recur.
exclude: Duplicating manufacturer/model/ownership facts or treating a planned trip as odometer history.
capture.workflow: Record the exact identifiers and validity dates of a registration under the selected vehicle. Append a renewal separately. Link scans as evidence and use Maintenance for repairs.
